mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_student) AS totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_teacher) AS totalTeachers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_course WHERE status = 1) AS totalCourses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_homework WHERE status = 1) AS totalHomework, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stu_id) FROM my_study_record WHERE study_date = CURDATE()) AS todayStudyCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(error_count), 0) FROM my_error_book WHERE is_mastered = 0) AS totalErrorQuestions

SELECT c.chat_id, COALESCE(u.real_name, CONCAT('学生', c.stu_id)) AS student_name, c.question, c.answer, c.create_time FROM my_ai_chat c LEFT JOIN my_student s ON c.stu_id = s.stu_id LEFT JOIN my_sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.answer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_student) AS totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stu_id) FROM my_study_record WHERE create_time >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) END) AS activeStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_teacher) AS totalTeachers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.teacher_id) FROM my_teacher t LEFT JOIN my_sys_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM my_homework h WHERE h.teacher_id = t.teacher_id AND h.update_time >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) END ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM my_course c WHERE c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id AND c.update_time >= CASE WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) END ) )) AS activeTeachers

SELECT s.class_name, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.correct_rate), 2), 0) AS avg_correct_rate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.study_duration), 0), 0) AS avg_study_duration, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.completed_homework), 0), 0) AS avg_completed_homework, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(sr.rank_score), 0), 0) AS avg_rank_score, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(sr.total_questions), 0), 0) AS avg_total_questions FROM my_student s LEFT JOIN my_study_report r ON s.stu_id = r.stu_id AND r.report_type = 2 LEFT JOIN my_student sr ON s.stu_id = sr.stu_id WHERE s.class_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.class_name ORDER BY avg_correct_rate DESC

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_name, c.current_person, c.type, COALESCE(u.real_name, '未知教师') AS teacher_name FROM my_course c LEFT JOIN my_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN my_sys_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.current_person DESC LIMIT 10
